steps.name: partide buyuk pirina
steps.sql: select min(id) from materials where production_product_type_id = 5 and status = 'active' and current_location_type = 'production_batch' and quantity >= 1000

steps.name: partide 20 kg pirina
steps.sql: update materials set quantity = 20 where id = (select min(id) from materials where production_product_type_id = 5 and status = 'active' and current_location_type = 'production_batch' and quantity < 100) returning id

steps.name: tuketilmis ayvalik yagi
steps.sql: select min(id) from materials where production_product_type_id = 4 and status = 'consumed'

steps.name: ayvalik partisinin son prosesi
steps.sql: select max(p.id) from batch_processes p join production_batch_output_production_product_types o on o.production_batch_id = p.production_batch_id and o.production_product_type_id = 4

steps.name: dinlenen ilk parti yagi
steps.sql: select min(id) from materials where status = 'active' and current_location_type = 'storage_unit' and current_location_id = 7

steps.name: dinlenen son parti yagi
steps.sql: select max(id) from materials where status = 'active' and current_location_type = 'storage_unit' and current_location_id = 7
